coverage.evidence: TargetTemplateHelpers.cs:24 registers the people rows under the namespace target (PeopleIdentityHelpers.cs:20,41, plus the Points, Profile, Streak, Twitch, Channel and Follow groups: 19 target rows). TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:710-776 registers the 27 legacy target forms, among them target.data.<key> (738) and target.verb:<sing|plur> (772). 19 plus 27 is 46, which matches the page description. The verb form takes two forms split on a bar (LegacyTemplateHelpers.cs:214-233).

LegacyTemplateHelpers.cs:956-1017 (known, id, name, displayname, with the Twitch lookup and the typed-word fallback), 818-822 (not following or unknown), 659-665 (lowercased twitch.tv link), 1285-1308 (stat zeros, 0m from WatchTimeFormatter.cs:19-22, unknown, days at least 1, whole-number avgperday and botpercent), 1586/1619/1654 with 1672-1681 (cut at 80 to 77, and at 200 to 197, with ...). The People groups cover the N0 counts, the yyyy-MM-dd dates, the empty colour, 0 viewers when offline, an empty rank, and the activity steps 10/100/500 (ViewerActivitySteps.cs:21-23).

TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:62-68 sets TriggerContexts to Command, EventResponse, Pipeline and Webhook, used by every target row at 710-776. PeopleRow.cs:88-94 gives the same four contexts to each people row. Timer is a separate context (TemplateHelperContext.cs:26-27) and is not in that list.

ChatMessageHandler.cs:1911-1917 seeds target from the first argument only, through MentionParser.cs:30-31, which trims and strips the @, and leaves it empty when there are no arguments. Caller-to-target seeding happens only at TwitchAlertHandlerBase.cs:258 (TemplateSubject.SeedTargetFromUser, TemplateSubject.cs:63-82), which is the event path, never the command path.

With an empty target: displayname is set to empty (LegacyTemplateHelpers.cs:597-598), known is false (602-603), the pronoun fallback is they, them, their, are, were, person (1447-1491), so the verb form takes the plural. Data keys are empty and stats are zero, 0m or unknown (1263-1308). The message helpers are empty (1565-1654). link and name/id/followAge are never set (583-594, 661-664). The people provider skips the ViewerData lookup (DbViewerDirectory.cs:70; PeopleHelperProvider.cs:68,79), so mention, shoutoutLink, the Twitch, channel and points rows, stats.*, and activity.level stay as written (TemplateTreeRenderer.cs:46).

The stats come from the per-channel profile (LegacyTemplateHelpers.cs:1277-1308). stats.streak reads WatchStreak (ViewerAnalyticsService.cs:143-151), which is written only from Twitch's watch_streak chat notification, where streak_count is consecutive broadcasts (ChatTranslators.cs:450-462; WatchStreakHandler.cs:121-150). The message filters are IsCommand, DeletedAt, empty and link prefixes, and the length limits are 80, 200 and >5 (LegacyTemplateHelpers.cs:1575-1641, 1672-1678).

reader_answers.evidence: Among the target forms, only target.verb takes arguments (TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:772; LegacyTemplateHelpers.cs:224-233). target.data.<key> is a key prefix (TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:738-741). The if helper treats an empty value as false (LogicArguments.cs:31-35; IfTemplateHelpers.cs:85-88), so the if form takes its else branch.
TriggerContexts covers Command, EventResponse, Pipeline and Webhook, with no Timer (TemplateHelperRegistry.cs:62-68). The target is the first word after the command (ChatMessageHandler.cs:1911-1917).
user is seeded from the message author (ChatMessageHandler.cs:1858-1860) and target from the argument (1917). target.known is true only for a stored user row (LegacyTemplateHelpers.cs:956, 602-603).

ResolveUnseenTargetAsync takes the display name from Twitch, or the typed word on a miss or failure (LegacyTemplateHelpers.cs:1001-1017). With no argument, target is empty and target.displayname is empty (ChatMessageHandler.cs:1912-1917; LegacyTemplateHelpers.cs:597-598). Nothing seeds the caller on the command path (TemplateSubject.SeedTargetFromUser is called only at TwitchAlertHandlerBase.cs:258).
